svg.title: Görkem Gül — I like neural networks.
svg.desc: I like neural networks. Görkem Gül. Applied AI, Agentic AI, I2T, T2I. A small neural network switching between image, text and audio tasks, next to a smiling neuron character holding a tiny black hole.
